name: omp-semantic-policy
description: Semantic policy enforcement for Oh My Pi

showStatus.description: Show semantic policy state in OMP's native status bar.

showViolationFeedback.description: Show session feedback when policy denies, revises, or requires approval for an action.

confirmationDefault.description: Automatically deny or approve confirmation requests that remain below the configured confirmation threshold.

confirmationThreshold.description: Ask for confirmation at or above this confidence. Set 0 to ask for every confirmation request; the default 1 disables dialogs.

enabledToolCalls.description: Comma-separated exact OMP tool names to evaluate. Empty evaluates every tool call; use this as an allowlist when only selected tools need checks.

disabledToolCalls.description: Comma-separated exact OMP tool names that bypass semantic policy evaluation, for example bash. Empty keeps all current enforcement defaults.

scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
